newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bond futures end higher, dull session.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bond futures end higher, dull session.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Portuguese bond futures ended higher and cash was steady after an apathetic session in which the Bank of Portugal left key rates unchanged.
*Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 67 bps vs 67 bps
Portuguese 10-year bonds were supported by the force of Italian BTPs in a quiet session and dealers said spreads against Bunds could narrow slightly tomorrow towards 60 basis points.
They said the yield curve flattened today and could flatten further if expectations grow of an Italian rate cut.
"It was an apathetic day, with small rises in bond futures and cash ending steady," a dealer said.
Another said: "Even though 10-year bonds did not gain ground on Bunds, the force of the BTP gave them great support."
